unit.why: A brief anecdote: a hasid hands the tsaddik a kvitl with a pidyon, and the tsaddik answers with a humble homily on Jeremiah and charity to the unworthy. The homily makes up most of the text.

stories.start_quote: פ״א נתן לו חסיד א׳ קוויטיל
stories.summary_en: When a hasid gives him a kvitl with a pidyon, the tsaddik says he is not truly a 'good Jew' (rebbe). He then explains through Jeremiah's curse on the men of Anathoth that charity given to an unworthy recipient awakens heavenly mercy for the unworthy giver.
